title: test(html): test `html` templating
body:
## Summary

This PR tests `html` templating in widgets.

Inline snapshots don't work in loops, so we can't use the `test.each` API without using separate snapshots. I reckon both the `test.each` format and the separate snapshots create a lot of mental overhead and bring little benefits, so I went for separate tests even if it means we can't ensure each templating solution produces the same output. This sounds acceptable for now.

I found that some template types were wrong while testing, so I fixed some of them. It will take a more extensive job to verify everything, we should do it separately and use the opportunity to refactor and eliminate the problem altogether.

## Next steps

After discussing it with @Haroenv we agreed that the current test specs for widgets aren't satisfactory anymore because they don't test widgets like a real user would do. Additionally, they're not exhaustive. This PR introduces templating tests in new test specs (using the `.test.{ts,tsx}` suffix instead of the legacy `-test.{ts,tsx}` one) where we'll then be able to progressively migrate existing tests while refactoring them.
